title: Fractal
description: A fractal entry returned by the Fractales static API

description.description: Short mathematical description of the iteration formula or construction method

family.description: Family identifier: evasion=escape-time, formule=free-form formulas, dynamique=attractors/basins, ifs=iterated function systems, lsystem=L-system curves, magnetique=magnetic renormalization, lisse=smooth coloring, orbitrap=orbit trap, distance=distance estimation, classe=OOP demo

render_mode.description: Rendering approach used by the viewer

is_3d.description: True if rendered in a 3D WebGL context

parameters.description: Extra parameters accepted by this fractal

has_julia_c.description: Fractal accepts a complex parameter c (Julia sets)

has_power.description: Fractal accepts an integer degree parameter d (Multibrot)

language.description: Implementation language (multilingual, a French-syntax language compiled to WebAssembly)

python_url.description: URL of the auto-transpiled Python equivalent

preset.description: Default view preset in complex plane coordinates

span.description: Total visible width in complex plane units at 800px reference width

default_pixelsize.description: Default pixel size (span / 800). Use as ps= in deep links for the default zoom.

deep_link.description: Ready-to-use viewer URL that opens this fractal at its default view with aurora palette
